occurrences.text: And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.
For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.
By stretching forth thine hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
